description: This file defines a controller class for user settings in a web application, handling actions such as viewing and updating account details, changing passwords, managing organizations and projects.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Settings
classes.description: A controller class managing user settings, including account info, password changes, organization and project management.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up common submenu items for the settings pages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Redirects to the account page by default.

methods.name: account
methods.description: Displays account settings, including email change options.

methods.name: change_display_name
methods.description: Handles updating the user's display name.

methods.name: change_password
methods.description: Handles password change requests, including validation.

methods.name: organizations
methods.description: Displays organizations associated with the user.

methods.name: projects
methods.description: Displays projects associated with the user.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Helper method to add a message and redirect to the index.
